ZH-HSK5-01-001.notes: 与其 introduces the option being rejected, and 不如 the one recommended; the order is fixed, rejected first. The frame weighs two courses of action, so both halves need a verb phrase (看电视 / 出去走走).

ZH-HSK5-01-002.notes: 不如 heads the preferred option after a 与其 clause and is never followed by 是. On its own, 不如 also makes a suggestion: 不如走路吧 (why don't we walk?).

ZH-HSK5-01-003.notes: 宁可 marks the sacrifice the speaker is willing to accept (going hungry), and 也不 the thing refused. It's about the speaker's own choice, unlike 与其…不如, which advises.
ZH-HSK5-01-003.tip: 与其…不如 recommends; 宁可…也不 states a personal choice at a cost.

ZH-HSK5-01-004.notes: The second half of the 宁可 frame is 也不 + the refused action; 也 is essential and goes after any subject. 宁愿 is an interchangeable alternative to 宁可.

ZH-HSK5-02-001.notes: 连老师都不会 gives an extreme case, and 我 is a weaker case that follows from it: 何况 (let alone). It's often rhetorical, ending in 呢.

ZH-HSK5-02-002.notes: 更不用说 + noun / clause + 了 = not to mention. Like 何况, it follows a 连…都 clause, but it's a statement, not a rhetorical question.

ZH-HSK5-02-003.notes: 况且 adds a further, independent reason (the rain) to one already given (the hour). Unlike 何况, it doesn't argue a fortiori; 而且 or 再说 are near-synonyms.
ZH-HSK5-02-003.tip: 何况 = let alone (a weaker case follows); 况且 = besides (another reason).

ZH-HSK5-02-004.notes: 中国 and 全世界 form a widening scope, linked by 乃至 (and even). It's written and formal, often followed by 都 or 也.

ZH-HSK5-03-001.notes: 以便 introduces a purpose that the first action makes easier (contacting you); 以免 introduces an outcome to be avoided (getting soaked). Both are formal and head the second clause.

ZH-HSK5-03-002.notes: 免得 is the colloquial counterpart of 以免: so as not to. It heads the second clause and introduces the unwanted outcome, here being late.
ZH-HSK5-03-002.text: 早点儿走吧，{{c1::免得::so as to avoid (colloquial; not 省得)}}迟到。
ZH-HSK5-03-002.flag: hint: 省得 fitted equally; added (not 省得)

ZH-HSK5-03-003.notes: 他担心 is an outcome to be avoided, and the colloquial linker is 省得 (so as not to), literally 'saving' the trouble. It's interchangeable with 免得 in most contexts.
ZH-HSK5-03-003.text: 你直接给他打个电话，{{c1::省得::so as not to (colloquial; not 免得)}}他担心。
ZH-HSK5-03-003.tr: Just give him a ring so he won't worry.
ZH-HSK5-03-003.flag: dup: replaced 早点儿走，省得迟到 (near-identical to HSK5-03-002); moved from HSK6 Supplement; hint adds (not 免得)

ZH-HSK5-04-001.notes: 假如 introduces a hypothetical or counterfactual condition (if I were you), followed by 就 in the main clause. 假如 and 假设 are more literary than 如果.

ZH-HSK5-04-002.notes: 带上手机 is a precaution against an unwelcome possibility: 万一 (in case, if by any chance). As a noun it appears in 以防万一 (just in case).

ZH-HSK5-04-003.notes: 即便 is a more literary form of 即使: even if, paired with 也. The condition is hypothetical, here a possible failure.
ZH-HSK5-04-003.text: {{c1::即便::even if (formal; not 即使)}}失败了，也不要放弃。
ZH-HSK5-04-003.flag: hint: 即使 fitted equally; added (not 即使)

ZH-HSK5-04-004.notes: 固然 concedes a point (money is admittedly important) before a 但 clause that outweighs it. It goes after the subject and implies the speaker agrees with the conceded point.

ZH-HSK5-04-005.notes: 我也要去 with 也 needs a concessive condition, and the spoken one is 就算 (even if). 哪怕 is a near-synonym that stresses an extreme case.
ZH-HSK5-04-005.text: {{c1::就算::even if (spoken; not 哪怕)}}你不同意，我也要去。
ZH-HSK5-04-005.tr: Even if you don't agree, I'm going.
ZH-HSK5-04-005.flag: dup: replaced 就算下雨，我们也去 (flagged against HSK4-01-004); hint adds (not 哪怕)

ZH-HSK5-04-006.notes: 我就迟到了 describes something that didn't happen, so the condition is counterfactual: 要不是 (if it weren't for). The main clause usually has 就 or 早就 and 了.

ZH-HSK5-04-007.notes: 不论 belongs to the 无论 / 不管 family: no matter, followed by an open question (结果怎样) and 都 in the main clause. It's slightly more formal than 不管.
ZH-HSK5-04-007.text: {{c1::不论::no matter (not 无论 or 不管)}}结果怎样，我们都接受。
ZH-HSK5-04-007.tr: Whatever the outcome, we'll accept it.
ZH-HSK5-04-007.flag: dup: replaced 不论多难，我都要试试 (same as HSK4-01-002 with 无论)

ZH-HSK5-05-001.notes: 贵的东西 and 好 form a generalisation being denied, in formal style: 未必 (not necessarily). 不一定 is the neutral equivalent and 不见得 the colloquial one.
ZH-HSK5-05-001.text: 贵的东西{{c1::未必::not necessarily (formal; two characters)}}好。
ZH-HSK5-05-001.flag: hint: 不一定 / 不见得 fitted equally; added (formal; two characters)

ZH-HSK5-05-002.notes: 他说的…是真的 is a claim the speaker doubts, voiced colloquially with 不见得 (not necessarily). It goes before the predicate and can't be used for a plain fact.

ZH-HSK5-05-003.notes: 刚开始工作 makes mistakes understandable, so 难免 (bound to, hard to avoid), usually followed by 会 + the unwelcome event.

ZH-HSK5-05-004.notes: 第一次上台 explains a natural emotional reaction, so 不免 (can't help), followed by the feeling (有些紧张). Unlike 难免, it rarely takes 会.
ZH-HSK5-05-004.text: 第一次上台，他{{c1::不免::can't help but (not 难免)}}有些紧张。
ZH-HSK5-05-004.flag: hint: 难免 fitted equally; added (not 难免)

ZH-HSK5-05-005.notes: 这点小事 is too trivial for anger, so 不至于 (not go so far as to) denies the extreme reaction. With final 吧 it becomes a gentle appeal: surely not.

ZH-HSK5-05-006.notes: 已经知道了 is an inference the speaker hedges: 似乎 (seem), the written counterpart of 好像. It goes before the predicate.
ZH-HSK5-05-006.flag: hint: 好像 fitted equally; added (written)

ZH-HSK5-05-007.notes: 没有准备好 is a confident conclusion from visible evidence: 显然 (obviously). It can open the sentence (显然，他没有准备好) or follow the subject.

ZH-HSK5-05-008.notes: The exclamation mark and a solo ride to Shanghai mark disbelief: 居然 (to everyone's surprise), a near-synonym of 竟然, slightly more colloquial.
ZH-HSK5-05-008.text: 他{{c1::居然::unexpectedly (surprise; not 竟然)}}一个人骑车去了上海！
ZH-HSK5-05-008.flag: hint: 竟然 fitted equally; added (not 竟然)

ZH-HSK5-05-009.notes: 不然我就忘了 names the bad outcome that was avoided, so the first clause takes 幸亏 (luckily). 幸好 is a near-synonym.

ZH-HSK5-05-010.notes: 呢 closing a question about spending so much signals a rhetorical question: 何必 (why bother). It can stand before a verb phrase or alone: 何必呢?
ZH-HSK5-05-010.text: {{c1::何必::why bother (rhetorical)}}花这么多钱买一个包呢？
ZH-HSK5-05-010.tr: Why spend so much money on a handbag?
ZH-HSK5-05-010.flag: dup: replaced 何必为这点小事生气呢 (overlapped with HSK5-05-005)

ZH-HSK5-05-011.notes: 我们才按时完成 shows the result depended on the help: 多亏 (thanks to). Unlike 幸亏, 多亏 always names the helper.
ZH-HSK5-05-011.text: {{c1::多亏::thanks to}}你帮忙，我们才按时完成。
ZH-HSK5-05-011.tr: Thanks to your help, we finished on time.
ZH-HSK5-05-011.flag: text: 多亏你帮忙 alone read as a fragment; added the result clause

ZH-HSK5-05-012.notes: 他会来 is an uncertain prediction, voiced colloquially with 说不定 (maybe), which can open the sentence. 也许 and 可能 are neutral alternatives.

ZH-HSK5-05-013.notes: 开个玩笑 is being played down, so 只不过 (merely, just), from 只是 + 不过. 开个玩笑 also omits 一 before the measure word, as speech often does.

ZH-HSK5-05-014.notes: 没人受伤 is the one good aspect of a bad situation, so 好在 (fortunately), opening its clause like 幸亏. It's colloquial and often follows a mishap just described.

ZH-HSK5-05-015.notes: 就想起她 is a recurring reaction, so the trigger takes 每当 (whenever); 就 or 总 follows in the main clause. 每当…的时候 is the fuller form.

ZH-HSK5-05-016.notes: 很准时 describes long-standing character, so 一向 (consistently, as always). 向来 is a more formal synonym.
ZH-HSK5-05-016.text: 他{{c1::一向::always (consistently; not 总是)}}很准时。
ZH-HSK5-05-016.flag: hint: 总是 fitted equally; added (not 总是)

ZH-HSK5-05-017.notes: 没说话 lasted throughout the whole span, so 始终 (from start to finish), which often precedes a negative. It's more formal than 一直.

ZH-HSK5-05-018.notes: 在…发展 is an ongoing process, and 不断 (continuously) sits between 在 and the verb of development. It suggests no pause at all.

ZH-HSK5-05-019.notes: 变冷了 is a change by degrees, in formal style: 逐渐 (gradually), the counterpart of 渐渐. Unlike 渐渐, it isn't reduplicated.

ZH-HSK5-05-020.notes: 请…回复 is a request in correspondence, and the standard urgency word is 尽快 (as soon as possible). 尽 is read jǐn, as in 尽量.

ZH-HSK5-05-021.notes: 大家 is plural, and leaving in quick succession is 纷纷 (one after another). The subject must be plural; 纷纷 can't describe one person.

ZH-HSK5-05-022.notes: 回到了小时候 is impossible literally, so it's an impression: 仿佛 (as if), a literary counterpart of 好像. It often describes returning to the past.

ZH-HSK5-06-001.notes: 加以 + two-syllable verb (研究) is a formal frame: apply study to it. The real action is in the following verb; 加以 itself has no meaning of its own.

ZH-HSK5-06-002.notes: 将 + a two-syllable verb (支持) in an official reply calls for 予以 (give, grant), a formal dummy verb. 予以批准 (grant approval) is another typical use.

ZH-HSK5-06-003.notes: 进行 + two-syllable verb (讨论) is the dummy verb of formal style: carry out a discussion. The real verb can't take its own object here; the object comes in with 对.

ZH-HSK5-06-004.notes: 受到 + noun (欢迎, 批评, 影响) = receive, meet with. It works as a neutral passive and, unlike 被, isn't restricted to unwelcome events.

ZH-HSK5-06-005.notes: 帮助 is an abstract noun in a formal thank-you, so 给予 (give), here in a relative clause: 大家给予的帮助. Its reading is jǐyǔ.

ZH-HSK5-06-006.notes: 学生 is the role in which someone should act, introduced by 作为 (as), followed by a comma. 当 can do the same job in speech: 当学生的.

ZH-HSK5-06-007.notes: 为…所 + verb is a literary passive: 为人所知 = known by people. 为 is read wéi here, and 所 sits right before the verb.

ZH-HSK5-07-001.notes: 便 is the written equivalent of 就: then, right away. It follows the subject or the time clause and precedes the verb.

ZH-HSK5-07-002.notes: 北京 identifies 中国的首都 in formal style: 即 (that is, namely), the written equivalent of 就是. In speech, 中国的首都是北京 would be the norm.
ZH-HSK5-07-002.flag: tr: removed the grammar gloss (formal: 即 = 就是) from the translation

ZH-HSK5-07-003.notes: 提高了效率 is the result brought about by improving the method: 从而 (thereby). The subject of both clauses is the same and isn't repeated.

ZH-HSK5-07-004.notes: 还 in the clause adds a further point, which is opened by 此外 (in addition) and a comma. It's written; speech uses 另外 or 还有.

ZH-HSK5-07-005.notes: 这次旅行很成功 is the conclusion of an account, opened by the four-character 总而言之 (all in all), the more formal version of 总之.
ZH-HSK5-07-005.text: {{c1::总而言之::all in all (four characters)}}，这次旅行很成功。
ZH-HSK5-07-005.flag: hint: 总之 fitted equally; added (four characters)

ZH-HSK5-07-006.notes: 这个方法是有效的 is a conclusion drawn from evidence just given: 由此可见 (from this it can be seen). It's typical of essays and reports.

ZH-HSK5-07-007.notes: 我们需要重新开始 restates a point more plainly, opened by 换句话说 (in other words) and a comma. 换言之 is the literary version and 也就是说 the neutral one.
ZH-HSK5-07-007.text: {{c1::换句话说::in other words (not 也就是说)}}，我们需要重新开始。
ZH-HSK5-07-007.flag: hint: 也就是说 fitted equally; added (not 也就是说)

ZH-HSK5-07-008.notes: 也太晚了 is a second reason after 太累了, added in speech by 再说 (besides). It's colloquial and also means 'we'll see later': 以后再说.

ZH-HSK5-07-009.notes: 二来 in the second clause requires 一来 in the first: for one thing…, for another…. It's often followed by a conclusion, and 三来 can extend the list.

ZH-HSK5-07-010.notes: 我们得自己做 spells out the consequence of his absence: 也就是说 (that is to say), neutral in register and usually followed by a comma.
ZH-HSK5-07-010.text: 他明天不来，{{c1::也就是说::that is to say (not 换句话说)}}，我们得自己做。
ZH-HSK5-07-010.flag: hint: 换句话说 fitted equally; added (not 换句话说)

ZH-HSK5-08-001.notes: 决定了 is a decisive event with lasting consequences, introduced by 一旦 (once); 就 heads the consequence. It can refer to the future or to general truths.

ZH-HSK5-08-002.notes: 都 in the main clause and an unrestricted group (参加的人) call for 凡是 (all, without exception), at the head of the noun phrase. It's formal and emphatic.

ZH-HSK5-08-003.notes: 客套话 (polite formulas) is being belittled, so 无非 (nothing but), usually followed by 是. 不过是 is the neutral equivalent.

ZH-HSK5-08-004.notes: 不是 A，而是 B corrects a wrong assumption: it's not A but B. 而是 is required in the second half; 但是 would be wrong.

ZH-HSK5-08-005.notes: 与其说 A，不如说 B = it's not so much A as B, a correction of description rather than of choice. Compare 与其…不如 without 说, which recommends an action.

ZH-HSK5-08-006.notes: 在 + person + 看来 = in someone's view; the person sits inside the frame. It opens the sentence and is followed by a comma.

ZH-HSK5-08-007.notes: 拿 + example + 来说 = take… for example, introducing a specific case to support a general point. 就拿…来说 is the common emphatic form.

ZH-HSK5-08-008.notes: 与 + B + 相比 = compared with B, opening the sentence. 跟…比 is the spoken counterpart, and 比起 is another alternative.

ZH-HSK5-08-009.notes: 想…想去 is the frame V来V去 (over and over), needing 来 in the first half. 还是 then introduces the conclusion finally reached.

ZH-HSK5-09-001.notes: 番 counts speeches, efforts and experiences, usually with 一: 一番话, 一番努力. It suggests something substantial or deliberate.

ZH-HSK5-09-002.notes: 届 counts year groups of students and recurring sessions: 这届学生, 第十届奥运会 (the 10th Olympics). It's always used with events that recur.

ZH-HSK5-09-003.notes: 架 counts aircraft and some framed objects: 一架飞机, 一架钢琴. 飞过 + new noun is an appearance pattern, like 走过来一个人.

ZH-HSK5-09-004.notes: 艘 counts ships and boats; 条 is the everyday alternative for small boats. 停着 shows the ship moored there.

ZH-HSK5-09-005.notes: 束 counts bundles or bunches, especially of flowers: 一束花 (a bouquet). It also counts beams of light (一束光).

ZH-HSK5-09-006.notes: 串 counts things strung or clustered together: a bunch of keys, a string of beads, a bunch of grapes (一串葡萄), a kebab (一串羊肉串).

ZH-HSK5-09-007.notes: 堆 counts heaps and piles: 一堆书, 一堆衣服. Colloquially it also means 'loads of', often with a note of complaint: 一堆问题.

ZH-HSK5-09-008.notes: 滴 counts drops of liquid. In 一滴水也没有, it combines with the 'not a single' pattern (一 + MW + 也 + negative).

ZH-HSK5-09-009.notes: 道 counts exam questions (一道题) and dishes in a meal (一道菜), as well as doors, walls and beams of light (一道光). 题 alone is short for 问题 or 习题.

ZH-HSK5-09-010.notes: 根 counts long, thin objects: rope, sticks, needles, hairs. 条 is used for longer flexible things such as roads and rivers.

ZH-HSK5-09-011.notes: ABB adjectives add a vivid suffix to a base: 绿 + 油油 = lush green. They take a closing 的 and can't take 很.

ZH-HSK5-09-012.notes: 热乎乎 (热 + 乎乎) is a warm, homely ABB form, usually for food or a pleasant feeling. Before a noun it takes 的.

ZH-HSK5-09-013.notes: Colour or state adjectives of the type 雪白 (snow-white) reduplicate as ABAB: 雪白雪白. Ordinary adjectives use AABB instead (干干净净).
